name: Slack
description: 把 Slack 里给 bot 的私信、@ 它的消息变成 Gerdr 事件（slack/dm、slack/mention、slack/message）。面板用 triggers/ 决定听不听、收到后做什么；面板要回复时发一个 slack.send 事件，由它贴回 Slack。

settings.title: Bot Token
settings.description: xoxb-…：Slack app 的 Install to Workspace 之后拿到。

settings.title: App Token
settings.description: xapp-…：Basic Information → App-Level Tokens，scope 选 connections:write（Socket Mode 用，不需要公网地址）。

settings.title: 只收这些人的消息
settings.description: Slack 用户 ID（U0XXXX），逗号分隔。空着 = 谁的都收。消息内容会交给 agent，强烈建议只放自己。

settings.title: 频道里不 @ 也收
settings.description: 打开后 bot 在的频道里每条消息都发成 slack/message 事件（需要 channels:history / groups:history）。默认只收私信和 @。

settings.title: 附件大小上限
settings.description: 消息里的图片、文件下到本机（需要 files:read），路径放进事件。0 = 不下。

en.name: Slack
en.description: Turns direct messages to your Slack bot and @-mentions of it into Gerdr events (slack/dm, slack/mention, slack/message). Panels decide with triggers/ whether to listen and what to do; to answer, a panel emits a slack.send event and this posts it back to Slack.

appToken.title: App Token
appToken.description: xapp-…: Basic Information → App-Level Tokens, scope connections:write (Socket Mode: no public address needed).

allow.title: Only from these people
allow.description: Slack user IDs (U0XXXX), comma separated. Empty = everyone. Messages reach agents: list only yourself if you can.

channelMessages.title: Channel messages without @
channelMessages.description: Every message in channels the bot is in becomes a slack/message event (needs channels:history / groups:history). Off: only DMs and mentions.

maxFileMB.title: Attachment size limit
maxFileMB.description: Images and files in a message are downloaded (needs files:read) and their paths put in the event. 0 = don't.
